name: code-change-discipline
description: Stop the agent from grepping its way through a large repo. Three skills — a discovery ladder over a code knowledge graph with silent-truncation detection, LSP as the tiebreaker, narrow-window editing and verification by test count; a sweeping-change playbook for migrations that outgrow one context; and a codebase-memory query reference — plus SessionStart and SubagentStart hooks that make sure the discipline is actually invoked. Requires codebase-memory-mcp.
